name: Library
text: You find yourself in a library surrounded by shelves of ancient books.

pass.text: You discover an ancient tome with gold hidden away.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} discovered an ancient tome with gold hidden away, and followed its pages out.

fail.text: You pull the wrong book and the entire shelf begins to fall. You are crushed to death under the weight.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} pulled the wrong book and the entire shelf came down. {{cap .Pronouns.They}} {{.Pronouns.Was}} crushed to death under the weight.

name: Bedroom
text: A moldy old mattress sits in the corner of the room. Some broken wooden furniture still collects dust.

pass.text: You see a rusty knife under the mattress and pocket it.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} pocketed a rusty knife from under the mattress and pried the door open.

fail.text: Something beneath the bed grabs your ankle. You are dragged away never to be seen again.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} felt something beneath the bed grab {{.Pronouns.Their}} ankle, and {{.Pronouns.Was}} dragged away, never to be seen again.

name: Flooded Chamber
text: An underground room is flooded with murky, stagnant water. It looks shallow enough to wade across.

pass.text: You manage to wade through the foul water without incident.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} waded through the foul water without incident and climbed out the other side.

fail.text: Something moves beneath the water. You are suddenly pulled under. Everything goes dark.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} felt something move beneath the water, and {{.Pronouns.Was}} suddenly pulled under. Everything went dark.

name: Kitchen
text: In this room, pots and pans hang from the ceiling, and everything is covered in a thick layer of dust.

pass.text: You find a coin purse with gold under the table.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} found a coin purse with gold under the table and slipped out through the larder.

fail.text: You open a cupboard and a family of rats explodes out of it. They gnash and bite at you until you succumb to your wounds.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} opened a cupboard and a family of rats exploded out of it. The rats gnashed and bit until {{.Pronouns.They}} succumbed to {{.Pronouns.Their}} wounds.

name: The Stairs
text: You don't notice the stairs. You take one step. Then there is nothing beneath your foot.

pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} caught {{.Pronouns.Them}}self just in time and climbed the rest of the way.

fail.text: You fall to your death. Somehow hitting every single step on the way down.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} fell to {{.Pronouns.Their}} death, somehow hitting every single step on the way down.

name: Ceiling Collapse
text: As you turn a corner, you hear a crack above you.

pass.text: You look up just in time to dive out of the way of the incoming rubble.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} dove out of the way of the falling rubble and scrambled through the gap.

fail.text: You look up just in time to see the ceiling collapse. You are crushed to death under the rubble.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} looked up just in time to see the ceiling collapse, and {{.Pronouns.Was}} crushed to death under the rubble.

name: Floor Collapse
text: You descend further into the dungeon. The ground suddenly gives way under your feet.

pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} leapt to safety as the floor gave way.

fail.text: You attempt to jump to safe ground but the rest of the floor collapses around you as you fall into eternal darkness.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} tried to jump to safe ground, but the rest of the floor collapsed and {{.Pronouns.They}} fell into eternal darkness.

name: Flood
text: Water suddenly begins pouring into the room.

pass.text: You manage to stop the flow of the water and escape just in time!
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} stopped the flow of the water just in time and swam out.

fail.text: The water rises too fast. Everything goes black.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} couldn't stop the rising water. Everything went black.

name: Arrow Trap
text: You turn down a corridor and notice a tiny hole in the wall.

pass.text: You move past it carefully and manage to avoid setting off the trap.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} moved carefully past the trap without setting it off.

fail.text: Before you realize what is going on, an arrow shoots out of the wall and pierces you in the neck.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} never saw the arrow that shot out of the wall and pierced {{.Pronouns.Them}} in the neck.

name: Trap Door
text: You walk down the hallway but something about the floor seems strange.

pass.text: You notice the trap door in time and hop over it before continuing down the hallway.
pass.epilogue: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} noticed a trap door in time and hopped over it before continuing down the hallway.

fail.text: You step directly onto the trap door and fall into darkness.
fail.obituary: {{cap .Pronouns.They}} stepped directly onto the trap door and fell into darkness.
